continuousAvailability.reason: Praxis is a CLI and a local server, not an operated service: it accepts no remote work and has no durable queue. Retry and recovery already must respect idempotency and unknown-effect state for repository mutation, package installation, Git operations and agent/provider invocation (requirements/SHARED-APPLICATION-FOUNDATIONS.md, Aegis item 4).

cacheReadiness.reason: No server-side query workload; Praxis reads repository files and its own local state directly.

reliabilityByConstruction.reason: No operated runtime or service-level commitments; correctness is established by the test suite and repository validation, not by runtime reliability machinery.
